about_the_game:
This game is a 3d-platformer, but instead of jumping by yourself you're using pogo, which was inspired by 3D Hopper tech demo for Nintendo 3DS.

Select one of your favourite cat characters (including Neco-Arc!), try yourself on 25 levels in 5 different settings, and get ready to fall down. A lot.

Features:

  • very non-usual way to make a 3d-platformer

  • low system requirements (you can play it on everything that supports at least OpenGL 3.2)

  • ton of gameplay in a small size (10 hours in 250 MB)

  • a lot of cool music from the unknown authors

  • 4 of your favourite cat characters (including PlanetClue and Neco Arc)

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04
  • Processor: Intel Celeron 420
  • Memory: 256 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce 8300GS/8400GS
  • Storage: 285 MB available space
  • Sound Card: The built-in one
  • VR Support: None of them, i'm too poor for this
  • Additional Notes: Also supports Uwuntu, ARM32 systems are not supported
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E7500
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTS 250 (DirectX 10) OR NVidia GeForce GTS 450 (DirectX 11)
  • Storage: 310 MB available space
  • Sound Card: The generic one
  • VR Support: None of them, i'm too rich for this
  • Additional Notes: Requires a special version to run on ARM64/Raspberry Pi (get it for free on itch.io)
